title: YouTube AdFree
shortDescription: Development build with server-side ad skipping and playback diagnostics.
description: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. DEV revision 10 keeps diagnostics v6 and the revision 9 Shorts improvements, but now uses the exact isAdPlayback=true response as a high-confidence trigger for guarded player-level skipping of server-side ad items. The response boolean is not mutated; instead the current ad player is briefly hidden while GTV seeks the ad item to its own duration, with an HTMLVideoElement fallback when the player API is unavailable. Every Shorts removal remains controlled by the existing Remove Shorts setting.

added: Player-level server-side ad skipping triggered only by an exact top-level isAdPlayback=true response.
A guarded HTMLVideoElement currentTime fallback when YouTube's player seekTo API is unavailable.
Regression coverage for player-level ad skipping and its early adblock integration.
changed: The ad-playback response remains unmodified and now acts as a trigger rather than an attempted server-state override.
DEV version advanced to 10690.5.3 / GTV revision 10.
fixed: Targets the server-side ad path observed on hardware where isInlinePlaybackNoAd was already true, no known feed ad renderer survived, and the correlated player response carried adBreakHeartbeatParams plus sendSsdaiMissingAdBreakReasons.
